objective_value: <float> Total expected cost combining facility opening costs and the probability-weighted transportation costs across all demand scenarios.
open_facilities: <list[int]> Identifiers of the facilities selected to be opened.
x: <dict, key: '{facility}'> Whether each facility is opened (1 = opened, 0 = closed).
y: <dict, nested keys: '{scenario}' -> '{facility}' -> '{customer}'> Quantity shipped from each facility to each customer under each demand scenario.
